clusters.label: dark-mode theming
clusters.summary: Three forks independently added a dark color theme with dimmed ANSI output. Strong convergence — a clean candidate to upstream.

clusters.label: wasm build target
clusters.summary: Two forks compile tldr to WebAssembly so the client runs in a browser. Different approaches, same goal.

clusters.label: locale support
clusters.summary: Three forks add language locales upstream doesn't ship (fr, de, ja). Low conflict, high demand signal.

signal.summary: Adds a dark-mode color theme with a dimmed ANSI palette and a config switch.
signal.reasoning: Two commits introduce a complete theme system: a new dark.css token set plus a config flag. Self-contained, no upstream conflicts — the most polished of the three dark-mode forks.

signal.summary: Adds dark theme support for terminal output.
signal.reasoning: Overlaps heavily with alice's theme tokens, reached independently — the core of the dark-mode cluster.

signal.summary: Dark theme plus a short docs note on enabling it.
signal.reasoning: Same theme direction with documentation added — rounds out the cluster.

signal.summary: Compiles the renderer to WebAssembly for an in-browser tldr.
signal.reasoning: Adds a wasm build step and a JS loader. Ambitious; would need a build-pipeline discussion to upstream.

signal.summary: Tweaks the build matrix to emit a wasm artifact.
signal.reasoning: Build-config sibling to dan's wasm work; same goal via CI config.

signal.summary: Adds a French locale for command descriptions.
signal.reasoning: New locale file, no code changes — easy to adopt.

signal.summary: German locale plus a small i18n loader refactor.
signal.reasoning: Goes a step beyond a locale file by generalizing the loader — the most reusable of the i18n forks.
Locale-only addition, mirrors ivan — completes the locale cluster.

signal.summary: Fixes column alignment for wide CJK characters.
signal.reasoning: Corrects a real width-calculation bug in the renderer; a clear upstream candidate.

signal.summary: Extracts the page parser into its own module.
signal.reasoning: Internal restructuring, no behavior change. Useful but not urgent.
Lockfile churn only — low significance, filtered from digests by default.
Removes dead legacy code. Safe, but a deliberate upstream policy call.

signal.summary: Cuts a tagged v2 release off the fork with a changelog.
signal.reasoning: Fork is being maintained as its own release line — worth watching for divergence.
